description: Most expected wire-format strings in the smoke tests are spec-derived oracles: 'direct'/'group'/'channel' (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 line 426), 'text/plain'/'text/markdown' (line 181), 'displayed'/'deleted'/'processed' (line 363), 'reactions/<id>' JSON-Pointer (line 328), 'chatId'/'sinceState' field names (RFC 8620), 'isPublic'/'muted' field names. Negative tests assert both error variant AND 'no HTTP request sent' invariant (a regression that fired a request before validating empty inputs would be caught). A future contributor might suggest 'just compare requests by round-tripping through the library' (i.e. using the code as its own oracle) — DO NOT accept that change. The hand-coded spec strings ARE the test integrity. Note: the serverRetryAfter test (JMAP-26di.3) is the one exception that violates this and is filed for fix.
title: DECISION: wire-format string oracles in tests are spec-derived, not generated
